description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline's setVideoWindow function, verifying its behavior when the IPC API succeeds or fails. It defines a test class inheriting from a base test class, sets up and tears down media pipeline instances, and includes two test cases.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineSetVideoWindowTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the setVideoWindow method of the media pipeline, inheriting from MediaPipelineTestBase.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys the media pipeline.
